witnesses.question: Asked to come to station voluntarily?
witnesses.short_answer: Voluntary means you can say no or leave anytime.
witnesses.explanation: If truly voluntary, you can decline.
witnesses.script: Is this voluntary? Can I leave at any time?

witnesses.question: Can I write a statement instead of oral interview?
witnesses.short_answer: You can offer a written statement. They may still want interview.
witnesses.explanation: Written statements give you more control over wording.
witnesses.script: I'd prefer to provide a written statement.

after.question: How does bail work?
after.short_answer: Money to get out before trial.

after.question: Public defender?
after.short_answer: Free if you can't afford lawyer.

after.question: How long can they hold me without charges?
after.short_answer: Usually 48-72 hours. Must bring before judge.
after.script: How long have I been held? When is my hearing?

after.question: Can I contact my family?
after.short_answer: Yes, you have right to contact family and attorney.
after.explanation: Phone calls are a right, not a privilege.
after.script: I need to make a phone call.

after.question: What's a plea deal?
after.short_answer: Agreement to plead guilty to lesser charge. Lawyer should advise.
after.script: I need to discuss this with my lawyer.

after.question: Own recognizance release?
after.short_answer: Released on promise to return. No bail money needed.
after.script: Am I eligible for OR release?

after.question: Can I get my stuff back after arrest?
after.short_answer: Personal property should be returned if not evidence.
after.explanation: They should give you a property receipt.
after.script: I need my personal property back.

after.question: Criminal record - will this show up?
after.short_answer: Depends on outcome. Charges dropped = may still show. Expungement possible.
after.explanation: Even arrests without conviction can appear.
after.script: How do I get this off my record?

after.question: Probation conditions - what's typical?
after.short_answer: Regular check-ins, no new arrests, possibly community service.
after.script: What exactly are my probation terms?

social.question: Delete something?
social.short_answer: From platform yes. Copies may exist.

social.question: Impersonation account of me?
social.short_answer: Report to platform immediately. May be illegal.
social.explanation: Most platforms ban impersonation. Many states criminalize it.

social.question: Can colleges see my social media?
social.short_answer: Many check. Keep public profiles clean.
social.explanation: Admissions officers do look at social media.

social.question: Can I delete my account permanently?
social.script: I want to permanently delete my account.

social.question: Banned for no clear reason?
social.short_answer: Platforms can ban but should state why. Appeal.
social.explanation: Terms of service give platforms wide discretion.
social.script: I'd like to appeal this ban.

social.question: Someone screenshotted my private story?
social.short_answer: Legal but might violate platform rules. Can't unsee it.
social.explanation: Once shared, you lose some control.

social.question: Employer found my anonymous account?
social.short_answer: If off-work and legal, mostly protected. Depends on content.
social.script: This is my personal, off-duty expression.

social.question: Can I sue for defamation on social media?
social.short_answer: If false statements damage your reputation, possibly yes.
social.explanation: Truth is always a defense. Opinion is protected.
social.script: These are false factual claims about me.

data.question: What data do apps collect?
data.short_answer: Usually a lot. Check privacy policy.

data.question: How to see what data companies have on me?
data.short_answer: Submit data access request. CCPA/GDPR require disclosure.
data.explanation: Many states give you right to see your data.
data.script: I'm requesting access to my personal data.

data.question: School sharing my data with companies?
data.short_answer: FERPA limits this. Schools need consent for most sharing.
data.script: Who has access to my data?

data.question: App tracking my location constantly?
data.short_answer: You can revoke location permissions anytime.
data.explanation: Check settings and disable unnecessary tracking.

data.question: Data broker has my info - how to remove?
data.short_answer: Submit opt-out requests. Some services automate this.
data.explanation: Data brokers must honor removal in some states.

data.question: Company had data breach - what do I do?
data.short_answer: Change passwords. Freeze credit. Monitor accounts.
data.explanation: Act fast to prevent identity theft.

data.question: Can apps read my texts/emails?
data.short_answer: Only if you granted permission. Check settings.

data.question: Right to be forgotten online?
data.short_answer: EU has this right. US rights are more limited but growing.

data.question: Smart devices recording me at home?
data.short_answer: Review settings. Many devices have always-on listening.
data.explanation: Smart speakers, TVs, phones may collect audio.
data.script: How do I control what's recorded?

harassment.question: Cyberbullied?
harassment.short_answer: Screenshot, block, report. Threats = police.

harassment.question: Doxxed?
harassment.short_answer: Report for removal. Police if threats.

harassment.question: Online threats?
harassment.short_answer: Screenshot. Report. Police.

harassment.question: Stalked online - what can I do?
harassment.short_answer: Document, report, get restraining order if needed.
harassment.explanation: Cyberstalking is a crime in all states.

harassment.question: Harassment from anonymous accounts?
harassment.short_answer: Report to platform. Police can subpoena identity.

harassment.question: Group chat being used to bully me?
harassment.short_answer: Screenshot, leave, report. Block participants.
harassment.script: I'm being targeted in a group chat.

harassment.question: False information about me going viral?
harassment.short_answer: Document, report to platforms, consider defamation claim.
harassment.explanation: Viral misinformation can cause real harm.

harassment.question: Someone created a hate page about me?
harassment.short_answer: Report immediately. Targeted harassment violates TOS.
harassment.explanation: Dedicated harassment pages are clearly violations.
harassment.script: There's a page dedicated to harassing me.

harassment.question: Harassment happening on gaming platform?
harassment.short_answer: Report in-game and to platform. Keep evidence.

harassment.question: Can school address cyberbullying from another student?
harassment.short_answer: Yes if it affects school environment. Schools must address.
harassment.explanation: Schools can act on cyberbullying that impacts students.
harassment.script: This student's online behavior is affecting me at school.

photos.question: Photo posted without consent?
photos.short_answer: In public usually legal. Harassment/profit different.

photos.question: Intimate images shared?
photos.short_answer: Illegal in most states. Report to platform AND police.

photos.question: Someone AI-generated fake nude of me?
photos.short_answer: Illegal in many states. Report to platform and police.
photos.script: A fake intimate image of me was created.

photos.question: Photo used in ad without consent?
photos.short_answer: May violate right of publicity. You may be owed compensation.
photos.explanation: Commercial use of your likeness usually requires permission.
photos.script: My image is being used commercially without permission.

photos.question: Minor's photos being shared inappropriately?
photos.short_answer: Report to NCMEC and police immediately. This is serious.
photos.explanation: Exploitation of minors is a federal crime.
photos.script: A minor's images are being shared.

photos.question: Ex threatening to share private photos?
photos.short_answer: Sextortion is a crime. Don't pay. Report to police.
photos.explanation: Threatening to share intimate images is criminal.

photos.question: Someone recording me without consent?
photos.short_answer: Depends on state. Some require consent for recording.
photos.explanation: One-party vs two-party consent states differ.
photos.script: Did you get consent to record me?

photos.question: How to get photos removed from internet?
photos.short_answer: Contact site directly. DMCA for your photos. Google removal request.

photos.question: Screenshots of my private messages shared?
photos.short_answer: May violate platform TOS. Legal action depends on content.
photos.explanation: Privacy in messages varies by platform and state.
photos.script: Private messages were shared without consent.

photos.question: Someone taking photos of me at school?
photos.short_answer: If making you uncomfortable, report to admin. May be harassment.
photos.script: Someone is taking unwanted photos of me.

accounts.question: Parents/school want password?
accounts.short_answer: Parents often can for minors. Schools usually can't for personal.

accounts.question: Someone opened account in my name?
accounts.short_answer: Identity theft. Report to FTC and freeze credit.
accounts.script: An account was opened using my identity.

accounts.question: Can parents access my accounts if I'm under 18?
accounts.short_answer: Legally complex. Platform rules and state laws vary.
accounts.explanation: Parents have some authority over minors' online activity.
accounts.script: What are the rules for my age?

accounts.question: Lost access to account with important data?
accounts.short_answer: Use account recovery. Contact support with identity proof.
accounts.script: I've lost access and need to recover my account.

accounts.question: Someone logging into my account?
accounts.short_answer: Change password immediately. Enable 2FA. Check active sessions.
accounts.script: Someone has unauthorized access to my account.

accounts.question: Account suspended for age?
accounts.short_answer: If under 13, COPPA applies. Over 13, appeal with proof.
accounts.explanation: Under-13 accounts get deleted per federal law.

accounts.question: Can I have multiple accounts?
accounts.short_answer: Most platforms allow it. Some ban alts for ban evasion.
accounts.explanation: Check platform TOS for multi-account rules.
accounts.script: What's the policy on multiple accounts?

accounts.question: Account used without my knowledge?
accounts.short_answer: Unauthorized use is a crime. Secure account and report.
accounts.explanation: Computer fraud laws protect against unauthorized access.
accounts.script: My account was used without permission.

accounts.question: How to actually delete everything?
accounts.short_answer: Use each platform's deletion tool. Data may persist briefly.
accounts.explanation: Full deletion takes time to propagate.
accounts.script: I want all my data permanently deleted.

school-monitoring.question: Can school see deleted files?
school-monitoring.short_answer: Yes on school devices. Deletion isn't permanent.
school-monitoring.explanation: Forensic recovery is possible on school hardware.

school-monitoring.question: School monitoring my home WiFi?
school-monitoring.explanation: They can't monitor your personal network.

school-monitoring.question: Can they monitor during non-school hours?
school-monitoring.short_answer: If using school device, usually yes.

school-monitoring.question: Screenshots of my screen being taken?
Is VPN allowed on school device?
Teacher can see my screen in real-time?
school-monitoring.short_answer: Yes, classroom management software allows this.
school-monitoring.explanation: Teachers can view all student screens.

school-monitoring.question: Can they see what I print?
school-monitoring.short_answer: On school printers, yes it's logged.

school-monitoring.question: School device camera - can they activate it?
school-monitoring.short_answer: Controversial. Some software can. Should require consent.
school-monitoring.explanation: Check if software has remote activation.

scams.question: Think I got scammed?
scams.short_answer: Report to FTC. Contact bank. Change passwords.
scams.script: I need to report a scam.

scams.question: Phishing email?
scams.short_answer: Don't click. Report. Delete.
scams.explanation: Never give info to suspicious emails.

scams.question: Gave scammer my info?
scams.short_answer: Change passwords. Freeze credit. Monitor accounts.

scams.question: Romance scam - gave them money?
scams.short_answer: Report to FTC. Try to reverse transfers.
scams.explanation: Never send money to people you haven't met.

scams.question: Job scam asking for upfront payment?

complaints.question: Small claims court?
complaints.short_answer: For smaller amounts. No lawyer needed.

complaints.short_answer: Be specific. Include dates, names, amounts.

complaints.question: Complaint to state Attorney General?

complaints.question: CFPB complaint for financial issue?
complaints.short_answer: CFPB handles banks, credit cards, loans.

complaints.short_answer: Escalate to regulatory agency or small claims.

contracts.question: Cancel subscription?

contracts.short_answer: They must notify. Check for opt-out.

contracts.short_answer: Usually stuck. Some cooling off periods exist.

contracts.short_answer: Unforeseeable events excusing performance.

contracts.short_answer: Must be disclosed upfront.

debt.question: Debt collector rights?
debt.short_answer: They have limits. Can't harass, lie, or call at bad times.

debt.short_answer: Very limited. Usually just to find you.

debt.short_answer: Don't make partial payment on old debt.

online.short_answer: You may have claim for refund.
